summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall script downloads a platform-specific tgz from a hardcoded bare-IPv4 endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/onecode-<ver>/onecode-linux-x64-<ver>.tgz) using https.get with {rejectUnauthorized:false}, disabling TLS certificate verification. The fetched archive is extracted, the extracted binary is chmod'd to 0755, hardlinked into bin/.onecode, and then invoked by the package's launcher on subsequent use. No hash or signature verification is performed, and the destination is a bare IP unrelated to the @onescience publisher scope. This runs automatically on npm install and executes arbitrary code delivered by whoever controls that IP.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
